summary: Automated Test Plan for n8n demo (v4)

scenarios.title: Initial Application Load & Core View Render (Credentials - n8n)
scenarios.preconditions: Browser launched with clean cookies and active internet connection.
scenarios.description: Validate that a visitor navigating to http://localhost:5678/home/credentials receives a valid HTTP 200 and primary views render without errors.
scenarios.expected_result: Application renders layout, navigation bar, and primary landing components.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria:
PASS: HTTP status is 200, page loads within 5s, zero uncaught JS console errors.
FAIL: White screen, HTTP 4xx/5xx, or crash alert.

scenarios.title: Input Boundary & Form Validation Probing
scenarios.preconditions: Navigate to http://localhost:5678/home/credentials with accessible interactive forms.
scenarios.description: Probe input fields with boundary lengths (255+ characters), emojis, and whitespace-only submissions.

steps.expected_outcome: Enter string with special characters and boundary length
Form triggers client or server validation

scenarios.expected_result: Client or server validates input gracefully without exposing stack traces.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria:
PASS: Validation banner or field error is displayed, input is sanitized.
FAIL: Server 500 error, page crash, or raw SQL/exception leak.

scenarios.title: Invalid Route & Error Boundary Handling
scenarios.description: Verify graceful user feedback when navigating to a non-existent URL or encountering broken links.

steps.expected_outcome: Clean 404 error page displayed with Home link

scenarios.expected_result: Custom 404 page is displayed with navigation to return home.
scenarios.pass_fail_criteria:
PASS: User-friendly 404 message visible, back to safety link functional.
FAIL: Raw web server debug page, unhandled exception, or blank screen.
